title: I Built a $30K/Month Business From a Remote Island (How I Work)
description:
Milly built her $30K/month business from a tiny, remote island with just an internet connection and a team of two. In this video, we do a day-in-the-life dive into how she actually built it from the middle of nowhere: how she spends her time, how she picks what to work on, and how she's deliberately built the whole thing around living a calm, low-stress life rather than chasing scale.
